text:
River,

Your hands are always cold. This is a fact I think about more than is strictly proportional to its significance, but there we are.

I want to be the person whose pockets you put them in. I want that to be such an ordinary thing that neither of us remarks on it. I want it the way other people want promotions or houses or clarity about the meaning of existence — except more, and significantly more specifically.

I love you. Warm hands, open pockets, the whole deal.

Gale
